IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen retry identity for one write, scoped to tenant, subject and operation.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable application identity for one user-organized workspace.

WorkspacePath.description: A relative path inside one workspace, in Unicode NFC, with `/` between segments. At most 4096 bytes in UTF-8: a character takes one to four.

description:
Delete a folder, with everything in it, in one committed change.

Archived items in the folder are deleted with it and are counted. A draft of a deleted item
is kept as a deleted item's draft is. A folder changed since `base_revision` is a `conflict`
with `ErrorDetail::StaleBase` on `/base_revision`; a folder that does not exist is
`not_found`.

base_revision.description: Exact revision on which this change is based; a folder changed since conflicts.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose permissions and storage scope apply.

title: DeleteFolderRequest
